name: glow
effect:glow
e:glow
description:
Makes the target entity glow (like with the Glowing potion effect).  

> Please note that this mechanic is not actually giving the *glowing* effect in any form: it will just *look* like it. If you want to check against the presence of this mechanic, you must check against the presence of the applied aura (an [hasaura](https://git.lumine.io/mythiccraft/MythicMobs/-/wikis/skills/conditions/hasaura) condition can do the trick, for instance)
